reviews.text:
We met Dr. Priscila in an emergency situation, with a tiny creature found on the street, at risk of death after likely being run over. We were referred by a Veterinary Hospital, and this was crucial in saving Chico's life, as it is rare to find a veterinarian specializing in wild animals.
She managed to save the life of our little Chico, who fought to survive and had Dr. Priscila as a true guardian angel in his life. Thanks to the dedication of this wonderful professional, Chico entered our lives in a very special way. We learned how to care for him, receiving all the guidance in handling and feeding. Over a period of care for his recovery, we learned to love him.

I also want to emphasize that this year Dr. Priscila also saved the lives of our little Catarina and Gertrudinha in situations that required emergency surgery. And thanks to her, our puppies are doing great!!
In this recovery and care process, we found in Dr. Priscila an incredible professional, extremely competent and above all "humane"!!!
Eternal gratitude, Dr. Priscila!!!

I can only express my gratitude for the care and attention given to my elderly cockatiel! Her surgery, although risky, was a success!!!
Thank you all so much! ♥️

I took my cockatiel Frajola on Saturday and we had a follow-up appointment today, Friday. We were more than well taken care of. Dr. Priscila was very meticulous and treated us with great care and attention. I have never been treated so well in a consultation.
I recommend her to everyone!!!

I want to thank the entire team at Espaço Pet Veterinary Clinic for their care, attention, and professionalism. From the very first appointment, I was very well received, and it's clear how much they care about each animal and their owners. The team is attentive, patient, and inspires a lot of confidence. It's wonderful to know that our pets are in such competent and dedicated hands. I recommend them without hesitation!

Words cannot express my gratitude to Dr. Manuella and the entire team for the care they gave my cockatiel!

Thank you so much!

There's really nothing to say, I've been taking my pets there for years and they're always treated with so much love and attention!
Aside from the surgeries already performed on the little ones, all of which were a success.
Excellent care for my wild pets... both consultations and hospitalization... the veterinarian is very experienced and skilled.... congratulations to the clinic.

I just have to thank Dr. Priscila for all the care she gave my pet.
The doctor is an exemplary professional and I recommend her to everyone.

Excellent professionals!

Dr. Priscila and her team are spectacular!

Congratulations on your work!

Success!

Excellent! Dr. Priscila is always attentive, caring, and competent.
I always recommend her.

Dr. Priscila is a great veterinarian; I travel over 20 km to consult my four-legged friends. She is caring, professional, and attentive.
The entire space was designed for your pet.
From the receptionist Cris to the accommodations and staff, everyone is highly trained and qualified to offer a humane and fraternal experience.
I recommend it because it's not just a clinic; it's a family-friendly space for your furry friends.
